# Miller

> Miller makes agent-ready and local-first tools for solo developers. Miller Start helps a
> developer and their coding agent move from an application idea to a maintainable production
> system without rebuilding authentication, billing, operations, and project conventions.

## Create an application

- [Create a Miller application](https://usemiller.dev/start.md): Agent-oriented, step-by-step
  instructions for naming, creating, configuring, running, and preparing a Miller Start app for
  production.
- [Miller Start](https://usemiller.dev/products/miller-start.md): Capabilities, architecture,
  intended users, and direct installer command.
- [Miller source repository](https://github.com/darraghoriordan/use-miller): Source code,
  releases, project documentation, and issue tracking.

## Products

- [All Miller products](https://usemiller.dev/products/index.md): Short product index.
- [Miller Start](https://usemiller.dev/products/miller-start.md): Agent-ready NestJS and Next.js
  application starter.
- [Miller Dev Shell](https://usemiller.dev/products/dev-shell.md): Reproducible developer
  environment for macOS and Windows WSL.
- [Miller Local Dev Tools](https://usemiller.dev/products/local-dev-tools.md): Local-first desktop
  developer utilities for macOS and Windows.

## Human-facing pages

- [Miller home](https://usemiller.dev/): Product overview.
- [Miller Start product page](https://usemiller.dev/miller-start): Application starter overview.
- [Dev Shell product page](https://usemiller.dev/dev-shell): Developer environment overview.
- [Local Dev Tools product page](https://usemiller.dev/local-dev-tools): Utilities and downloads.
- [Documentation](https://usemiller.dev/docs): Product documentation index.

## Repository documentation

- [Product contract](https://github.com/darraghoriordan/use-miller/blob/main/PRODUCT.md): Product
  principles and success criteria.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/darraghoriordan/use-miller/blob/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): Runtime
  boundaries and dependency policy.
- [Design](https://github.com/darraghoriordan/use-miller/blob/main/DESIGN.md): UI principles.
- [Agent guide](https://github.com/darraghoriordan/use-miller/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Durable
  repository instructions for coding agents.
- [Miller CLI](https://github.com/darraghoriordan/use-miller/blob/main/libs/project-setup/README.md):
  Reporting, provider setup, credential handling, and production orchestration.
- [create-miller](https://github.com/darraghoriordan/use-miller/blob/main/libs/create-miller/README.md):
  One-command npm installer.
- [Use Miller skill](https://github.com/darraghoriordan/use-miller/blob/main/skills/use-miller/SKILL.md):
  Workflow for operating an existing Miller application.
- [Create Miller skill](https://github.com/darraghoriordan/use-miller/blob/main/skills/create-miller/SKILL.md):
  Workflow for creating a new Miller application.

## Notes for agents

- Prefer the instructions in `start.md` when creating an application.
- Inside a generated application, its `AGENTS.md`, `miller.config.json`, and source code are the
  authority for that project.
- Use `mill report --profile all --json` to inspect readiness. Do not infer readiness from a
  marketing page or from `miller.config.json` alone.
- Never request, reveal, or commit secrets.
